name: Glowpath
summary: A skincare sales CRM with a drag-and-drop deal board and a live country map of orders
about: A sales CRM for a brand that sells online, on marketplaces and to shops, shown with sample data from a skincare company. A drawn country map shows sales by city while live orders arc out of the warehouse and land with a ping, retail deals move across a board of glowing product jars, and channels, products and stockists are all editable.
how: Use the floating dock at the bottom to move between the eight pages; icons grow as the pointer passes.
On Overview and Regions, watch orders fly from the warehouse to cities; hover or tap a city bubble, or open it for its channels and stockists.
On Deals, drag a product jar to the next stage; dropping it on Live adds the sales. Keyboard users press Shift with an arrow key or use the grip.
Search, filter and sort cities and retailers, and add, edit or delete stockists with undo.
Restock, edit or add products, and compare Online store, Marketplaces, Shops and Pharmacies on Channels.
In Settings, choose the warehouse city, switch the order arcs or alerts, change the theme or reset the demo data. Press Ctrl+K to search.
